title: Golden question record
description: One question in a golden set (dev/val/test). One JSON object per line in questions.jsonl.

id.description: Stable question id, e.g. S1, M14, H6, N7. Unique within a set.

set.description: Which corpus this record belongs to.

question.description: The exact question text as a user would ask it.

tier.description: Graph-traversal difficulty, or 'stress' for the post-hoc generalization probe questions.

kind.description: How a candidate answer is graded. 'schema-gap' means the correct answer is a named refusal (H10/H15 shape).

anchor.description: Whether the question names a specific resolvable entity.

author.description: Who wrote the question. Drives contamination assessment.

written_before_matcher.description: True if the question predates any matcher that could be tuned to it.

tuned_against.description: True if this question was visible while matchers/templates were being written. A good score on a tuned_against question is NOT evidence of generalization.

independent_recompute_needed.description: True if the golden answer was authored alongside the mechanism and must be recomputed via harness/compute_answer.py before anchoring a holdout claim.

source_doc.description: Where the question/answer originally came from, for traceability.

answer_ref.description: Path to the golden answer file, relative to this set dir (e.g. answers/M14.md).

notes.description: Free-text caveats (e.g. corrected entity names, FalkorDB bug exposure, date anchors).
